_comment: Manufacturing process knowledge base for the agentic CAD pipeline. Each process defines DFM constraints that drive the mesh inspector checks, feedback messages, and planner system prompt injection.

dfm_rules: Minimum wall thickness: 2.0mm (5x standard 0.4mm nozzle diameter for structural strength)
Overhangs exceeding 45° from horizontal require support material or bridging
Horizontal spans (bridges) over 30mm will sag without support
Minimum hole diameter 1.5mm — smaller holes collapse during printing
Avoid sharp internal corners — use fillets ≥0.5mm to prevent stress concentration and layer delamination
Layer height 0.1–0.3mm; feature detail below 0.2mm will not resolve

failure_guidance.thin_wall: Increase the wall thickness parameter. FDM requires ≥2.0mm for structural integrity with a 0.4mm nozzle. Thinner walls result in single-extrusion walls with poor layer adhesion.
failure_guidance.not_watertight: All FDM parts must be watertight solid meshes for the slicer to compute infill correctly. Fix boolean operations: embed sub-features 2mm into the parent body before union/fuse.
failure_guidance.overhang: Add support structures or redesign the geometry to stay within 45° overhang angle from vertical.

FDM.system_prompt_rules:
This part will be manufactured using FDM 3D printing (e.g., PLA, ABS, PETG with a 0.4mm nozzle).
  - MINIMUM WALL: 2.0mm everywhere, no exceptions. Thinner walls fail to print.
  - OVERHANGS: Keep all overhangs ≤45° from horizontal, or plan for support material.
  - BRIDGES: Horizontal spans >30mm need support below.
  - HOLES: Minimum 1.5mm diameter. Smaller holes will close during printing.
  - FILLETS: Use ≥0.5mm fillets on all sharp internal corners.

dfm_rules: Minimum wall thickness: 0.5mm — thinner walls may warp or break during post-processing
Hollow parts must have drain holes ≥3mm to allow uncured resin to escape
Large flat surfaces perpendicular to build direction cause suction cup forces — add reliefs
Overhangs >50° need support; minimize support contact points for cleaner surfaces
Post-cure shrinkage ~0.5–2% depending on resin — account for in precision features

failure_guidance.thin_wall: Increase wall thickness to ≥0.5mm. Resin walls thinner than 0.5mm are fragile and prone to warping during UV post-cure.
failure_guidance.not_watertight: Ensure the model is a watertight manifold. Open meshes cause resin to pool inside and fail to cure properly.

SLA.system_prompt_rules:
This part will be manufactured using SLA/DLP resin printing.
  - MINIMUM WALL: 0.5mm (thinner walls are fragile post-cure).
  - HOLLOW PARTS: Include ≥3mm drain holes for uncured resin escape.
  - OVERHANGS: Keep ≤50° from horizontal or use supports.
  - PRECISION: Typical tolerance ±0.1mm — suitable for detailed miniatures and dental/medical prototypes.

SLS.full_name: Selective Laser Sintering (SLS / Powder Bed Fusion)
dfm_rules: Minimum wall thickness: 0.7mm — thinner walls may not fully sinter and lack strength
No support structures needed — unsintered powder supports overhangs
Minimum clearance between moving parts: 0.5mm (powder can fuse thin gaps)
Hollow parts should have powder escape holes ≥5mm to remove unsintered powder
Nylon (PA12) SLS parts have ~3% linear shrinkage — account for in precision features
Wall thickness uniformity important to prevent warping during cool-down

failure_guidance.thin_wall: Increase wall thickness to ≥0.7mm. Thin SLS walls may not fully sinter, resulting in weak, porous structure.
failure_guidance.not_watertight: Watertight manifold required for slicer/sinter path generation. Fix boolean operations.

SLS.system_prompt_rules:
This part will be manufactured using SLS (Selective Laser Sintering / Powder Bed Fusion), typically Nylon PA12.
  - MINIMUM WALL: 0.7mm everywhere.
  - NO SUPPORTS NEEDED: Powder bed supports all overhangs. Design freely.
  - CLEARANCES: Gaps between parts must be ≥0.5mm to prevent powder fusion.
  - ESCAPE HOLES: Hollow volumes need ≥5mm holes for powder removal.
  - SHRINKAGE: ~3% linear — scale up features requiring tight tolerances.

dfm_rules: Minimum feature size limited by smallest available end mill (typically 0.5–1mm)
All internal corners must have radius ≥ tool radius (min ~0.5mm)
Tall thin walls (height:thickness > 3:1) vibrate and chatter during machining
Deep pockets require tool clearance — avoid features deeper than 3× tool diameter
Undercuts require special tooling or multi-axis setup
All surfaces must be accessible by the cutting tool from at least one direction

failure_guidance.thin_wall: Increase wall thickness to avoid vibration/chatter. For CNC, walls taller than 3× their thickness require special fixturing. Minimum practical wall: 0.5mm for metals, 1.0mm for plastics.
failure_guidance.not_watertight: Watertight mesh required for CAM toolpath generation. Fix self-intersecting or non-manifold geometry.

CNC.system_prompt_rules:
This part will be manufactured using CNC machining (milling or turning), likely from aluminum, steel, or engineering plastic.
  - MINIMUM FEATURE: 0.8mm (smallest practical end mill diameter).
  - INTERNAL CORNERS: Must have radius ≥0.5mm (tool radius). Sharp internal corners are impossible to machine.
  - WALL STABILITY: Avoid walls taller than 3× their thickness without additional ribbing.
  - TOLERANCES: CNC achieves ±0.05mm — precision features are feasible.
  - NO OVERHANGS: Undercuts require 5-axis machining or special fixturing.

dfm_rules: Draft angles of 1–3° required on ALL vertical surfaces for part ejection from mold
Uniform wall thickness (within ±60% variation) to prevent sink marks and warping
Minimum wall thickness 1.0mm (varies by material — ABS: 1.2–3.5mm, PP: 0.8–3.8mm)
Avoid sharp corners — use fillets ≥ 0.5× wall thickness to prevent stress concentration
Undercuts require side-actions or lifters (expensive tooling — avoid if possible)
Minimum hole diameter 1.0mm; through-holes preferred over blind holes
Ribs for stiffness: rib height ≤3× wall thickness, rib width = 0.5–0.7× wall thickness

failure_guidance.thin_wall: Increase wall thickness to ≥1.0mm. For injection molding, thin walls cause short shots (incomplete fill) and structural weakness. Use uniform wall thickness throughout.
failure_guidance.not_watertight: Watertight manifold required for mold flow simulation and tooling design. Fix boolean operations.

INJECTION_MOLDING.system_prompt_rules:
This part will be manufactured using injection molding (thermoplastic).
  - DRAFT ANGLES: ALL vertical surfaces need 1–3° draft for mold release. This is mandatory.
  - MINIMUM WALL: 1.0mm (ABS/Nylon typical: 1.5–3.0mm for best results).
  - WALL UNIFORMITY: Keep wall thickness variation within ±60% to prevent sink marks.
  - NO UNDERCUTS: Avoid features that would trap in the mold without side-actions.
  - FILLETS: All sharp corners need ≥0.5mm fillet to prevent stress cracking at gates.

CASTING.full_name: Metal Casting (Sand Casting / Investment Casting / Die Casting)
dfm_rules: Minimum wall thickness 3.0mm for sand casting (2.0mm for investment casting)
Draft angles 2–5° on all surfaces pulled from the mold/pattern
Uniform wall thickness to ensure even solidification and prevent porosity
Avoid sharp corners — use generous fillets (≥3mm) to prevent hot tears
Core prints needed for internal cavities
Machining stock allowance of 2–5mm on surfaces requiring precise dimensions

failure_guidance.thin_wall: Increase wall thickness to ≥3.0mm. Casting requires thick walls for metal flow and structural integrity. Thin sections cause cold shuts and misruns.
failure_guidance.not_watertight: Watertight mesh required for pattern making and mold fill simulation.

CASTING.system_prompt_rules:
This part will be manufactured using metal casting (sand, investment, or die casting).
  - MINIMUM WALL: 3.0mm (investment casting: 2.0mm minimum).
  - DRAFT ANGLES: 2–5° on all surfaces for pattern withdrawal.
  - FILLETS: Use generous fillets (≥3mm) at all corners to prevent hot tears.
  - UNIFORM WALL: Avoid abrupt section changes — use gradual tapers.
  - MACHINING STOCK: Add 2–5mm extra on surfaces that will be machined after casting.
